visualCharacteristics: Zig-zag rows of large image and vertically centered H2 + paragraph; differs from columns-product (no price/CTA, alternating sides, multiple rows).
contentPattern: Three image + text rows alternating sides (REBELLION, IDENTITÄT, GENUSS)
usage: One row per image/text pair. Put the cells in the order they should appear on desktop (image | text, then text | image, ...). The text cell holds an H2 and paragraphs. On mobile the image is always shown above the text.
reuseGuidance: Reuse for brand-story or value sections with alternating image and text. For a product teaser with price and CTA use columns-product.
